'''Team Rage''' was the name given to two members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, during their [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]] to prove Galactic Alliance [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]]'s corruption<ref name="MK" /> in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> [[Voort saBinring]] and [[Myri Antilles]] were tasked with flying their [[X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and strafing the launching pad of [[Chakham Army Base]], headquarters of the elite Alliance army unit the [[Pop-Dogs]], which was founded and led by Thaal, and destroying as many [[E-wing starfighter|E-wings]] as possible.<ref name="MK" /> 

Their next step was to fly up to [[Skifter Station]] and get the attention of [[Galactic Alliance Starfighter Command|Starfighter Command]], forcing it to send units down to the planet in order to act as witnesses to the evidence against Thaal and subsequently arresting him.<ref name="MK" />
